title: Shrink packaged crate under the crates.io 10 MiB limit

comments.author: home
comments.text: Intent: the release-plz publish of botspy v0.2.0 failed with HTTP 413 — the packaged crate is ~11.8 MiB, over the crates.io 10 MiB limit (docs/diagrams PNGs dominate). Fix: replace the `exclude` list in Cargo.toml with an explicit `include` allowlist (src/, features/ — which src/spec embeds via include_str! — Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, README.md, LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md). Verify with cargo package --list, cargo package (real .crate size), cargo publish --dry-run, and cargo test. Add a CI guard that fails if the .crate exceeds ~9 MiB. No publish/tag/main changes from this task.
